description: Defines an abstract class 'CombinedCondition' implementing logical condition combinators (<and>, <or>, <not>, <xor>) for a mini-language in the OFBiz framework, including nested factory classes for each condition type.

classes.name: CombinedCondition
classes.description: Abstract class implementing composite logical conditions (<and>, <or>, <not>, <xor>) with nested factory classes for each condition type.

classes.name: CombinedCondition.AndConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating 'and' condition instances.

classes.name: CombinedCondition.NotConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating 'not' condition instances.

classes.name: CombinedCondition.OrConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating 'or' condition instances.

classes.name: CombinedCondition.XorConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating 'xor' condition instances.

methods.name: CombinedCondition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes sub-conditions from XML elements.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the combined condition with specified logical operator.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Factory method to create specific combined condition instances (<and>, <or>, <not>, <xor>).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the condition type.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the condition based on the method context.
